features.notes: Neutral-light and low-angle captures retain the purple roof, blue stone and warm books/wood distinction. Pale lintels do not obscure openings; the side wall remains readable.

notes: Inspected five-view comparison and neutral/grazing captures at the same camera. Retained established warm upper-left key, sky/ground hemisphere and restrained fill rather than adding new stylistic effects. Added a three-option light comparison control; shadow maps update only when lighting changes. Contact shadows support the bench and pots. The original image has softer edges and different ambient context; lighting does not erase that remaining difference.
